Your lines, in English, timed against the customer audio the portal plays.

**How the demo runs.** Open the worklist, pick the customer named below, and click
**Call**. There is no phone and no join link: the portal plays the customer's Arabic
audio out loud through the laptop speakers and drives the transcript from it. Make sure
the room can hear the laptop before you start.

**The clock starts when you click Call.** Timestamps below are from that moment. Each
gap is 6 seconds and each line is 11-15 words, which lands around 5 seconds at a normal
pace. Finishing early is invisible; running long means the customer talks over you.

If you lose your place, let a gap pass in silence and rejoin at the next timestamp - a
missed line reads as a natural pause, a collision reads as broken.

The transcript and the AI insights on screen are produced by the real copilot reacting
to these lines, so they appear a second or two after each turn, exactly as in a live
call. Don't wait for them before speaking.
